gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.

gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.answer: No sooner had he been elected
gaps.lead: He was elected, and he broke his first promise immediately.
gaps.sentence: ___ than he broke his first promise.
gaps.explanation: Passive inversion: No sooner had he been elected than…

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.

gaps.lead: It was a mistake not to write the telephone number down.
gaps.sentence: I should ___ writing down the telephone number.
gaps.hint: make a point of doing = be sure to do
gaps.explanation: Regret about an omitted action: 'should have made a point of writing it down'.

gaps.lead: They won't let you in without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: let somebody do → be allowed to do: won't be allowed in.
